framework.name: Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science (built on the C3 Framework)
framework.note: Codes are the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science by strand (IS inquiry skills; CV civics; EC economics; H history) and by grade (K-5), band (6-8, with LC/MdC/MC complexity levels) or 9-12. The course teaches history only, never physical technique, so it cites history, civics and inquiry standards, not physical education; alignment is the course author's judgment and not a certification.
